duration.text: The Bachelor Programs for the deaf in Computer Science and Technology at Tianjin University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2277 USD/per year ￥ 16400 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above 6.Officially documented proof of audio disability

requirements.text: 1.18 to 60 years of age 2.International Applicants should be an HSK 4 holder. Those without a HSK certificate should come and take an entrance examination of Comprehensive Chinese one week before the new semester begins. Those who fail the entrance exam may take the Chinese course before they retake the Exam.
